Team — quick internal note and drafting suggestions. Quoting Rohan below for context.

> "we can offer a narrow operational telemetry license for service improvements and bug fixes, and we can explicitly exclude model fine-tuning/retraining unless Novum opts in via a separate addendum."

Suggested approach (legal):
1) Add a defined term: "Operational Telemetry" = aggregated, non-identifiable usage metrics and system performance logs used solely to improve service stability and performance. Explicitly exclude customer prompt/response content from that definition.
2) Add separate defined term: "Model Retraining" = deliberate use of customer data (including prompts and outputs) to alter model weights for production deployment. State that Model Retraining requires a separate written opt-in and commercial agreement (e.g., a training addendum).
3) Output/Derivative language: Accept customer ownership of Outputs for internal use and allowed productization as set forth in the Order Form, but preserve Redwood's right to develop generic models and improvements that do not contain customer-identifiable data. Provide a short non-exclusive license back to Redwood only to the extent necessary to maintain, debug and improve the service (but not for fine-tuning).

Red line snippets (for insertion into Order Form):
- "Operational Telemetry" definition and permitted use clause.
- "Model Retraining" opt-in clause: "Customer acknowledges that any Model Retraining using Customer Data requires separate written agreement and explicit commercial terms; absent such agreement, Redwood will not use Customer Data to train or fine-tune production models."
- Output ownership clause with carveouts for aggregated telemetry and for independently developed improvements.

Risks to highlight for sales: customers often push for broader derivative rights and to allow productization of outputs; we should confirm scope (internal-only vs. redistribution/commercialization). If Novum asks to retain unlimited downstream commercialization rights we may need a revenue share or stronger limitations.

I'll draft text and circulate a tracked-changes file in the morning.

Priyom Das
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
